suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: Harrison 来到她房间，转述护士说她不该离开。
facts.anchor: “The nurse said you shouldn’t have left.”

facts.fact: Harrison 退到门口保持距离，她为此感到刺痛。
facts.anchor: He still didn’t want to be close to me, and I wished that didn’t sting so much.

facts.fact: Harrison 说他无法把她一个人丢在这里，声音发颤，她辨认出那是恐惧。
facts.anchor: “I couldn’t leave you here.” His voice wavered.

facts.fact: Harrison 说自己不知道看到了什么，但确定听到了类似鳄鱼吼叫的声音，她因此松了口气。
facts.anchor: “But I definitely heard something. An alligator bellowing, I think.”

facts.fact: Harrison 急忙表示相信她，说自己也感觉到 vibe，并承认 Gazzie 在这件事上一直是对的。
facts.anchor: “I believe you,” he said quickly, like he thought that might make me stay.

facts.fact: 她背起包不答话，Harrison 猜到了答案：她要永远离开。
facts.anchor: He knew me well enough to guess the answer: I was leaving for good.

facts.fact: Harrison 把椅子拖到身前挡住去路，要求她看着自己。
facts.anchor: He scooted the chair to the left, blocking me again. “Dart, look at me.”

facts.fact: 她指控 Harrison 的阻拦是残忍的。
facts.anchor: “You’re being cruel.”

facts.fact: 她说出在医院里打好腹稿的告别词：感谢他没报警，承认自己知道做错了，宣布不再试图修好自己、要独自离开以免再伤人。
facts.anchor: “Thank you,” I began, voice miraculously stable, “for not telling the police. I’ll always be grateful for that.

facts.fact: 她哭喊让他放自己走，并保证他不必再见到她。
facts.anchor: “Just let me go,” I cried. I still couldn’t look him in the eye.

facts.fact: Harrison 用力叫出她的名字，使她终于抬头；他拿走拐杖扔到床上，握住她的双手轻轻打圈。
facts.anchor: Then he took both my hands in his, rubbing his thumbs in gentle circles on the backs of them.

facts.fact: Harrison 讲述他和 Ginny 在火前找到 Leon 的文件并对质 Gazzie，Gazzie 用螺栓枪打了 Ginny 的脸；他称她的所为是为保护他们的巨大牺牲。
facts.anchor: “Ginny and I found Leon’s papers where you left them in front of the fire,” he said.

facts.fact: Harrison 拥抱她、吻她的太阳穴，贴着她的头发求她别走。
facts.anchor: “Don’t go.” He spoke into my hair, his words ruffling the strands.

facts.fact: Harrison 请她留下，她自问怎么能够拒绝。
facts.anchor: “Stay,” he said, breath warm on my nose.

facts.fact: 她看见 Ida 肖像的残骸和插在其心脏处的斧头，打算请 Aunt Virginia 烧掉它和所有与它纠缠的肖像。
facts.anchor: I’d ask Aunt Virginia to burn her, and all the portraits entwined with her body parts.

facts.fact: 她捡起地上的 Ironheart 皮，完好无损，打算开车到 Egans Creek 把它还给沼泽。
facts.anchor: Balancing on one foot, I leaned over and picked it up. It was in perfect condition.

facts.fact: 她问 Aunt Virginia 是否已原谅她；Harrison 说螺栓枪打脸是最后一根稻草，被锁进房间时 Ginny 说 Gazzie 无可救药。
facts.anchor: “I think Gazzie hitting her with the bolt gun was the final straw.

facts.fact: 走出 Greer House 被 Aunt Virginia 拥抱时，她确信自己仍是那个把同学的头撞向水泥地并乐在其中的小女孩，从未改变。
facts.anchor: I’d never changed, no matter how often I’d told myself I had.

facts.fact: 她进而推论：若她的恶来自血统、不可避免，那么 Michelle、Mama 和 Gazzie 的死也都不是她的错。
facts.anchor: If my wickedness was inevitable, so, too, were their deaths.

facts.fact: 章末收束：她确认自己邪恶却也被爱，两者可以同时为真。
facts.anchor: I am wicked, and I am loved. Apparently, both things can be true.
